mapper.sql: run_id AS runId, flow_id AS flowId, flow_name_snapshot AS flowNameSnapshot, trigger_type AS triggerType, init_vars AS initVars, context_snapshot AS contextSnapshot, run_status AS runStatus, total_cost_ms AS totalCostMs, error_msg AS errorMsg, operator AS operator, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime

run_step_id AS runStepId, run_id AS runId, step_id AS stepId, step_name AS stepName, sort_order AS sortOrder, request_snapshot AS requestSnapshot, response_status AS responseStatus, response_body AS responseBody, extract_result AS extractResult, assert_result AS assertResult, step_status AS stepStatus, cost_ms AS costMs, error_msg AS errorMsg, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_run (flow_id, flow_name_snapshot, trigger_type, init_vars, run_status, operator) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{flowNameSnapshot}, #{triggerType}, #{initVars}, #{runStatus}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO flow_run_step (run_id, step_id, step_name, sort_order, request_snapshot, response_status, response_body, extract_result, assert_result, step_status, cost_ms, error_msg) VALUES (#{runId}, #{stepId}, #{stepName}, #{sortOrder}, #{requestSnapshot}, #{responseStatus}, #{responseBody}, #{extractResult}, #{assertResult}, #{stepStatus}, #{costMs}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_run_step SET response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_body = #{responseBody}, extract_result = #{extractResult}, assert_result = #{assertResult}, step_status = #{stepStatus}, cost_ms = #{costMs}, error_msg = #{errorMsg} WHERE run_step_id = #{runStepId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_run_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, run_step_id ASC
SELECT FROM flow_run ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
